RBI’s new prudential framework for stressed asset resolution credit positive: Moody’s

By:The Hindu BusinessLine - 10 June,2019

Short Detail

Moody’s Investors Service on Monday said the Reserve Bank’s new prudential framework for stressed asset resolution is ‘credit positive’, but flagged the slower-than-expected progress of resolution under Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code as a key hurdle.

RBISource:businessworld.in

The Reserve Bank of India’s (RBI) revised framework for the resolution of stressed assets is credit positive, because it brings back the focus on the need for the timely resolution of such assets, and the buildup of loan loss provisioning against those assets, Moody’s Investors Service VP Financial Institutions Group Alka Anbarasu said.

India extends Rs 1.6 billion aid to Nepal for rebuilding earthquake-hit houses

By:Business Standard - 10 June,2019

Short Detail

India on Monday extended a financial aid of 1.6 billion Nepalese rupees to Nepal to help 50,000 people in Nuwakot and Gorkha districts rebuild their houses damaged in the devastating earthquake in 2015.

The cheque for the same was handed over by India’s ambassador to Nepal Manjeev Singh Puri to Finance Secretary of Nepal Rajan Khanal.

Till now,India has granted Nepal a total of 4.5 billion Nepalese rupees under this project.
